drive_sources.title: Kymaean Visual Continuity Constitution
drive_sources.authority_boundary: Drive continuity law points to the intuition synthesis as qualitative prior/challenge checks while preserving newer live repository authority and frozen candidate criteria.

compatibility_findings: No contradiction with IMG-01's frozen human-specificity, representation-depth continuity, no-image fallback, monochrome/high-contrast, relational/causal, provenance, Stage-noncopy or anti-genericity requirements.
The prior explicitly keeps portrait/face presentation optional rather than prohibited; this is compatible with IMG-F1 as well as reduced/transforming representations.
The prior treats identity robustness as redundant system recoverability rather than one invariant feature; this is compatible with the IMG-01 identity floor and no-image fallback law.
Environmental response is contextual rather than mandatory; this prevents IMG-F3's field behavior from becoming a universal requirement.
Psychological expression remains suggestive by default but permits creator-authored, observable, perspective-safe overt expression; no frozen family is disqualified by this prior.
Visual history is presentation of authoritative history rather than an independent memory/causal system; this matches existing provenance and semantic-boundary law.

quarantine_law.prompt_construction: Generated exemplar prompts may use only the frozen IMG-01 method, Stage-0 manifest, frozen family definitions, controlled facts and already-authoritative source laws. Do not import wording, preferences or new distinctions from the Director prior into prompt construction.
quarantine_law.candidate_criteria: Do not add, remove, tighten or reinterpret frozen pass/fail criteria because of the Director prior.
quarantine_law.method_bound_evaluation: Evaluate exemplar evidence first against the frozen IMG-01 promotion floor and hard failures. Any qualitative observation influenced by the Director prior must be identified as such rather than disguised as preregistered law.
quarantine_law.prior_concordance: Only after method-bound evaluation is recorded may a separate concordance audit compare candidate behavior with the Director prior's qualitative lenses and working principles.
quarantine_law.selection_language: Do not describe the resulting Design Sol preference as blind or fully independent. State the exposure provenance explicitly.
quarantine_law.director_choice: The prior itself does not select F1/F2/F3 and does not convert later agreement with it into Director approval or convergence.
